description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)," across various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The LLaMA-3-8B-it model is represented by blue bars, while the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model is represented by orange bars. The chart shows that the LLaMA-3-8B-it model generally performs better than the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model across most benchmarks, with the highest score being around 80% for GSM-8K and the lowest being around 20% for Chat-Arena-Hard. The "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model shows more consistent performance across the benchmarks, with scores ranging from approximately 40% to 60%. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
